# CLI Reference

Habitat-Mapper installs one command line tool, `hab`. It is available in the
environment that `habitat-mapper` is installed into. Every command also accepts
`--help` to print this information in your terminal.

```console
hab COMMAND
```

Habitat segmentation of geospatial imagery with AI.

**Commands**:

* [`clean`](#hab-clean): Clear the Habitat-Mapper model cache to free up space. Models will be re-downloaded as needed.
* [`models`](#hab-models): List all available models with their latest revisions.
* [`revisions`](#hab-revisions): List all available revisions for a specific model.
* [`segment`](#hab-segment): Apply a segmentation model to an input raster and save the output.

## hab models

```console
hab models
```

List all available models with their latest revisions.

## hab revisions

```console
hab revisions MODEL
```

List all available revisions for a specific model.

**Parameters**:

* `MODEL, --model, -m`: The name of the model to run. Run `hab models` to see options **[required]**

## hab clean

```console
hab clean
```

Clear the Habitat-Mapper model cache to free up space. Models will be re-downloaded as needed.

## hab segment

```console
hab segment MODEL INPUT OUTPUT [ARGS]
```

Apply a segmentation model to an input raster and save the output.

**Parameters**:

* `MODEL, --model, -m`: The name of the model to run. Run `hab models` to see options **[required]**
* `INPUT, --input, -i`: Path to input raster file (GeoTIFF, etc.) or Sentinel-2 SAFE directory **[required]**
* `OUTPUT, --output, -o`: Path to the output raster that will be created **[required]**
* `REVISION, --revision, --rev`: The revision of the model to use. Run `hab revisions <model_name>` to see options *[default: latest]*
* `BATCH-SIZE, --batch-size`: Batch size for processing *[default: 1]*
* `CROP-SIZE, --crop-size, -z`: Tile size for processing (must be even). Defaults to the 1024 or to the size required by the model
* `BLUR, --blur`: Size of median blur kernel (must be odd, 0 to disable) *[default: 0]*
* `MORPH, --morph`: Size of morphological kernel (must be odd, 0 to disable) *[default: 0]*
* `BAND, --band, -b`: Band reordering flag for rearranging bands into RGB(+NIR) order when necessary.
* `QUIET, --quiet, -q, --no-quiet`: Suppress progress output and non-error log messages (errors are still shown). *[default: False]*
